defmodule ReportService.FileManager do
  @moduledoc """
  Manages temporary file creation for report generation in K8s pods.
  Uses pod-specific namespacing to avoid conflicts between replicas.
  """

  @base_tmp_dir "/tmp/reports"
  @k8s_shared_volume "/shared/reports"

  def init do
    File.mkdir_p!(@base_tmp_dir)
    File.mkdir_p!(@k8s_shared_volume)
  end

  @doc """
  Creates a workspace directory for report generation.
  Uses K8s downward API pod name for isolation between replicas.
  """
  def create_workspace(report_id, opts \\ []) do
    pod_name = System.get_env("POD_NAME") || "local"
    namespace = System.get_env("POD_NAMESPACE") || "default"
    isolation_mode = Keyword.get(opts, :isolation, :pod)

    workspace_path = build_workspace_path(report_id, pod_name, namespace, isolation_mode)

    case ensure_workspace(workspace_path) do
      :ok -> {:ok, workspace_path}
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp build_workspace_path(report_id, pod_name, namespace, :pod) do
    sanitized_id = sanitize_report_id(report_id)
    Path.join([@base_tmp_dir, namespace, pod_name, sanitized_id])
  end

  defp build_workspace_path(report_id, _pod_name, namespace, :shared) do
    sanitized_id = sanitize_report_id(report_id)
    Path.join([@k8s_shared_volume, namespace, sanitized_id])
  end

  defp sanitize_report_id(report_id) when is_binary(report_id) do
    report_id
    |> String.replace(~r/[^a-zA-Z0-9_\-]/, "")
    |> String.slice(0, 64)
  end

  defp sanitize_report_id(report_id), do: sanitize_report_id(to_string(report_id))

  defp ensure_workspace(path) do
    File.mkdir_p(path)
  end

  @doc """
  Creates a temporary file within the workspace for intermediate data.
  Uses cryptographically random names and exclusive creation to prevent
  race conditions and symlink attacks.
  """
  def create_temp_file(workspace_path, _content_hint, opts \\ []) do
    file_mode = Keyword.get(opts, :mode, 0o600)
    prefix = Keyword.get(opts, :prefix, "rpt")

    filename = generate_filename(prefix)
    file_path = Path.join(workspace_path, filename)

    case create_file_exclusive(file_path, file_mode) do
      {:ok, path} -> {:ok, path}
      {:error, :eexist} -> create_temp_file(workspace_path, _content_hint, opts)
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp generate_filename(prefix) do
    random_bytes = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(16) |> Base.encode16(case: :lower)
    "#{prefix}_#{random_bytes}.tmp"
  end

  defp create_file_exclusive(file_path, mode) do
    # Verify no symlink exists at target path (TOCTOU-safe via exclusive open)
    case File.lstat(file_path) do
      {:ok, %{type: :symlink}} -> {:error, :eexist}
      _ -> :ok
    end

    # Use exclusive flag to atomically create - prevents race conditions
    case File.open(file_path, [:write, :binary, :exclusive]) do
      {:ok, fd} ->
        File.close(fd)
        File.chmod(file_path, mode)
        {:ok, file_path}
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Writes report data to a temp file. Does NOT create symlinks to shared
  volumes - uses direct copy for cross-pod sharing to prevent symlink attacks.
  """
  def write_report_chunk(workspace_path, chunk_id, data, opts \\ []) do
    publish = Keyword.get(opts, :publish_shared, false)
    {:ok, file_path} = create_temp_file(workspace_path, "chunk_#{chunk_id}")

    case File.write(file_path, data) do
      :ok ->
        if publish do
          publish_to_shared(file_path, workspace_path, chunk_id)
        end
        {:ok, file_path}
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp publish_to_shared(file_path, workspace_path, chunk_id) do
    namespace = System.get_env("POD_NAMESPACE") || "default"
    shared_dir = Path.join([@k8s_shared_volume, namespace, "published"])
    File.mkdir_p!(shared_dir)

    # Copy file content instead of creating symlinks - prevents symlink-based attacks
    dest_name = Path.join(shared_dir, "#{Path.basename(workspace_path)}_#{chunk_id}.tmp")
    File.cp!(file_path, dest_name)
    File.chmod!(dest_name, 0o600)
  end

  @doc """
  Cleanup workspace - called by K8s preStop hook or periodic GC.
  Does NOT follow symlinks to prevent confused deputy attacks.
  """
  def cleanup_workspace(workspace_path, opts \\ []) do
    max_age_ms = Keyword.get(opts, :max_age_ms, 3_600_000)

    # Verify workspace is under expected base directories; halt if not.
    if safe_path?(workspace_path) do
      case File.ls(workspace_path) do
        {:ok, files} ->
          files
          |> Enum.each(fn file ->
            full_path = Path.join(workspace_path, file)
            cleanup_file(full_path, max_age_ms)
          end)
          File.rmdir(workspace_path)
        {:error, _} -> :ok
      end
    else
      {:error, :invalid_path}
    end
  end

  defp safe_path?(path) do
    expanded = Path.expand(path)
    String.starts_with?(expanded, @base_tmp_dir) or
      String.starts_with?(expanded, @k8s_shared_volume)
  end

  defp cleanup_file(path, max_age_ms) do
    case File.lstat(path) do
      {:ok, %{type: :symlink}} ->
        # Remove symlinks without following them
        File.rm(path)
      {:ok, %{type: :regular, mtime: mtime}} ->
        age = System.system_time(:second) - mtime_to_epoch(mtime)
        if age * 1000 > max_age_ms, do: File.rm(path)
      {:ok, %{type: :directory}} ->
        cleanup_workspace(path, max_age_ms: max_age_ms)
      _ -> :ok
    end
  end

  defp mtime_to_epoch({{y, m, d}, {h, min, s}}) do
    NaiveDateTime.new!(y, m, d, h, min, s)
    |> DateTime.from_naive!("Etc/UTC")
    |> DateTime.to_unix()
  end
end

defmodule ReportService.Generator do
  @moduledoc """
  Report generation pipeline that uses FileManager for temp storage.
  """
  alias ReportService.FileManager

  def generate_report(report_id, sections, opts \\ []) do
    with {:ok, workspace} <- FileManager.create_workspace(report_id, opts),
         :ok <- process_sections(workspace, sections, opts),
         {:ok, output} <- assemble_report(workspace, report_id) do
      # Schedule async cleanup after delivery
      Task.start(fn ->
        Process.sleep(30_000)
        FileManager.cleanup_workspace(workspace)
      end)
      {:ok, output}
    end
  end

  defp process_sections(workspace, sections, opts) do
    sections
    |> Enum.with_index()
    |> Enum.each(fn {section_data, idx} ->
      FileManager.write_report_chunk(workspace, idx, section_data, opts)
    end)
    :ok
  end

  defp assemble_report(workspace, report_id) do
    case File.ls(workspace) do
      {:ok, files} ->
        content = files
        |> Enum.sort()
        |> Enum.map(fn f ->
          full_path = Path.join(workspace, f)
          # Only read regular files, skip symlinks
          case File.lstat(full_path) do
            {:ok, %{type: :regular}} -> File.read!(full_path)
            _ -> ""
          end
        end)
        |> Enum.join("\n")

        output_path = Path.join(workspace, "#{report_id}_final.pdf")
        File.write!(output_path, content)
        {:ok, output_path}
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
    end
  end
end
